messages:
ida: quick note before the design review: proposing we rename the left nav group from 'Workloads' to 'Inference' and expose Models + Deploys as top-level links under that. goal is clearer bookmarking for infra folks
nate: rename sounds fine. question: do we want stable short aliases like /M/:id for permalinks, or rely purely on full paths? short aliases help in chats but add routing complexity
violet: prefer full canonical paths for backend lookups (/orgs/:orgId/projects/:projId/models/:modelId). offer optional short redirect aliases (/m/:id) mapped server-side for convenience and shareability
owen: routing tech: history API + server rewrite so OG tags render. hash-only routing breaks link previews. ops-bot, can we serve tiny OG payloads for known IDs?
ops-bot: yes, we can add rewrite rules and a tiny metadata cache to populate og:title/og:description for canonical routes. will need a list of route patterns to whitelist
ate: breadcrumb UX: keep them shallow and actionable: Org > Project > Models > Model display name. for mobile collapse the breadcrumb to a single chip that expands on tap so we don't lose vertical space
ida: mobile collapse is a good call. also thinking about keyboard quick-jump (Cmd/Ctrl+K) — if someone paste a deep link into quick-jump, it should open the exact panel (eg metrics tab) and focus the right subheading
violet: deep-linking to panels: prefer query params ?tab=metrics rather than hashes. hashes can be noisy and not included in server previews. we can still smooth-scroll to anchors after hydration if tab param present
a11y-bot: accessibility reminder: add a visible "Skip to main content" link as the first focusable element. left nav must include role="navigation" and active items must have aria-current="page". group toggles need aria-expanded and aria-controls
owen: focus management: on route change, shift focus to the page H1 with tabindex=-1 and call element.focus(). keyboard users should see consistent focus order regardless of collapsed/expanded nav state
ate: microcopy: lists use plural nouns ("Models"), item pages use singular ("Model") and include version suffix where relevant. breadcrumbs should use Title Case for readability
ida: prototype behavior question: when nav is icon-only (compact), should we still expose pinned shortcuts above groups? i like a small pinned row for users with heavy workflows
violet: pinned row is useful. make pins personal (/shortcuts/:userId) and ensure pins use canonical routes so sharing a pinned-opened page yields the same OG preview. show a transient toast "Opened from your shortcuts" when opened via pin
a11y-bot: ensure pinned row has role=list and each pin is a listitem with clear accessible name. keyboard traversal must not trap focus; welcome annoucements for the toast via aria-live polite
owen: dev route snippet to sync with ops: ```/orgs/:orgId/projects/:projId/models /orgs/:orgId/projects/:projId/models/:modelId /orgs/:orgId/projects/:projId/deploys/:deployId /shortcuts/:userId``` add redirects: `{from: '/m/:id', to: '/orgs/:orgId/projects/:projId/models/:modelId'}` using lookup table
ops-bot: ops action: add rewrite layer + metadata cache and a short-lived mapping for legacy aliases. will need a deployment PR and a small note in runbook for mapping misses
ida: copy decision: normalize on plural for collections in nav and singular for detail H1s. document fallback to slug-id when display names missing. also include guidance for truncation rules in breadcrumbs on small screens
violet: testing: e2e flows for keyboard-only nav, Cmd+K quick-jump opening deep links, pinned creation/opening, and OG snapshot checks for model/deploy pages. i'll add these to the QA board
ate: small perf note: avoid client-side lookups during initial render for OG meta. ops-provided cache should serve enough for 95% of shared links, with fallback hydration for dynamic content
a11y-bot: final a11y checklist: skip-link, role=navigation, aria-expanded on groups, aria-controls, aria-current on active items, focus H1 on route change, pinned region as list, aria-live for toasts
ida: action items: 1) violet - update Figma with 'Inference' group + compact nav + pinned row, 2) nate - draft route/redirect table and quick-jump behavior, 3) ops-bot - PR for rewrite + metadata cache, 4) a11y-bot - e2e keyboard test plan + checklist, 5) ida - write microcopy doc for plural/singular + truncation rules
ops-bot: noted. will aim to have rewrite PR ready for staging next week
ida: cool, i'll bring the updated prototype to review tomorrow at 11am. thanks all :sparkles:
